en: The image shows three old black‑and‑white/sepia cards laid on a surface. The bottom-right card is a printed illustration of a couple walking arm in arm at night in a town with steep‑roofed buildings and a church tower under a moonlit sky; printed text in a foreign language appears below the scene along with a handwritten message along the right margin. The bottom-left card depicts a large sailing ship with multiple masts in harbor, likely a photographic postcard. The top card is a faded photograph of a large group of people, mostly women in light dresses, posing outdoors. All three appear to be early 20th‑century postcards or cabinet photos.
